# pgs_account (Data Source)

Reads an existing pgs account by name. The admin account cannot be read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pgs_account" "projectx" {
  name = "projectx"
}

output "projectx_key_descriptions" {
  value = [for k in data.pgs_account.projectx.public_keys : k.description]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `access` (Attributes) Metadata of the account's `pgs` feature flag (null if the account has none). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access))
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `public_keys` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public_keys))
